+    limit = 2.0

+    # Build adjacency list
+    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
+    for u, v, w in edges:

+        adj[v].append((u, w))

+    # Greedy construction
+    sides = [0] * n
+    for i in range(n):
+        # Calculate gain for placing i on side 0 vs side 1
+        gain_0 = 0
+        gain_1 = 0
+        for v, w in adj[i]:
+            if sides[v] == 0:
+                gain_0 += w  # Edge (i, v) is cut if i is on side 1
+                gain_1 -= w # Edge (i, v) is NOT cut if i is on side 1 (both on 0)
+            else:
+                gain_0 -= w # Edge (i, v) is NOT cut if i is on side 0 (both on 1)
+                gain_1 += w # Edge (i, v) is cut if i is on side 1
+        
+        # Choose the side that gives higher gain
+        if gain_1 > gain_0:
+            sides[i] = 1
+            
+    # One-flip local search
+    improved = True
+    while improved:
+        if time.process_time() - start_time > limit:
+            break
+        improved = False
+        for i in range(n):
+            # Calculate gain for flipping node i
+            flip_gain = 0
+            for v, w in adj[i]:
+                if sides[v] == sides[i]:
+                    flip_gain += w # Edge becomes cut
+                else:
+                    flip_gain -= w # Edge stops being cut
+            
+            if flip_gain > 0:
+                sides[i] = 1 - sides[i]
